description: Save a small JSON object under a namespace and key, for an agent to read back later. It is not for secrets or personal data; values with obvious secret or contact-detail shapes are refused. The namespace must have been granted to this API key.

key.description: The entry's key within the namespace, up to 200 characters.

namespace.description: A context namespace this key has been granted, for example supplier_rules.

scope_ref.description: Optional label for what the entry is about, up to 200 characters. Not secret.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional lifetime in seconds, up to 90 days.

value.description: The JSON object to save, up to 16 KiB.

name: rr_save_memory_entry
